# tsuga_custom_role (Resource)

Custom global role granting its holders access to Tsuga assets within a team scope, and to telemetry signals

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tsuga_custom_role" "example" {
  name        = "platform-on-call"
  description = "Edits monitors and dashboards of the platform team, and reads its production telemetry."

  team_scope = {
    type     = "specific"
    team_ids = ["abc-123-def"]
  }

  assets = {
    team             = "read"
    dashboard        = "write"
    monitor          = "write"
    "monitor-folder" = "read"
  }

  telemetry = ["log", "metric", "trace"]

  telemetry_query = [
    {
      key    = "context.env"
      values = ["production"]
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `assets` (Map of String) Access level granted per Tsuga asset type within the team scope, 'read' or 'write'. 'write' also grants read access. An asset type absent from the map grants no access, and 'team' is required. Keys are API resource types such as 'dashboard', 'monitor-folder' or 'ingestion-api-key'; 'database', 'inventory', 'queue', 'service', 'audit-log' only accept 'read'
- `name` (String) Name of the custom role, unique across the organization, in kebab-case (lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, such as 'platform-on-call')
- `team_scope` (Attributes) Teams the role grants its asset permissions on (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--team_scope))
- `telemetry` (Set of String) Telemetry signals the role can read: 'log', 'metric', 'trace', 'rum'. An empty set grants no telemetry access

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the custom role
- `telemetry_query` (Attributes List) Additional restriction applied cluster-side to every telemetry query the role holder runs. Each entry keeps only the data points whose key matches one of its values, and entries are combined with AND (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--telemetry_query))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the custom role

<a id="nestedatt--team_scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `team_scope`

Required:

- `type` (String) Scope type: 'all' covers every team, 'public' covers public teams only, 'specific' covers the listed teams, 'all-except' covers every team but the listed ones

Optional:

- `team_ids` (Set of String) Team IDs the scope applies to (required when type is 'specific' or 'all-except', not allowed otherwise)


<a id="nestedatt--telemetry_query"></a>
### Nested Schema for `telemetry_query`

Required:

- `key` (String) Attribute key matched against telemetry data points, such as 'env' or 'service.name'
- `values` (List of String) Values the attribute must equal for a data point to be kept. A data point matching any of them is kept
